references.text: The same pattern with Ephraim and Zebulun who did not drive out the Canaanites but let them live among them
Naphtali had the same experience as Asher—they did not drive out the inhabitants but lived among the Canaanites
The angel of the Lord rebukes Israel for not driving out the peoples in the land, which was a breach of the covenant
The description of the tribal territory of Asher and the cities they inherited, including the Canaanite cities they were to take over
Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites in Gezer, another example of disobedience
Manasseh also failed to drive out the inhabitants from several towns, following the same pattern of disobedience
Moses warned that if they did not drive out the inhabitants, they would become like thorns in their eyes
